ITEM 1 | Large mound of off-white, pale cream-colored crumbly/fluffy pieces with irregular cauliflower-like clumps and soft curd-like texture, matte with slight sheen, covering most of the upper plate; roughly 16 cm across and 3-4 cm tall in heaps, holds loose shape without flowing | 260
ITEM 2 | Cubed orange pieces, bright orange with slightly glossy skin-like surface and fibrous interior edges, cut into roughly 2-3 cm chunks, arranged along the lower edge of the mound; some pieces appear lightly caramelized at edges | 90
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, slightly glossy pieces partly hidden under the pale mound near the lower center, soft-looking with uneven edges, about 1-2 cm pieces, sitting directly on the plate beside the orange cubes | 25
